title: Scalable Best-of-N Selection for Large Language Models via Self-Certainty
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: A NeurIPS 2025 Best-of-N selector that scores each sampled response from its full token distributions and optionally combines confidence rank with answer frequency through Borda voting.
这项 NeurIPS 2025 工作用完整词元分布为每个采样回答打分以做 Best-of-N 选择，并可通过 Borda 投票把置信度排名与答案频次结合。
why: For rollout/search/test-time trace curation, it specifies the candidates, token-distribution scores, ranks, extraction states, votes, and selected output, while exposing the gap between intrinsic confidence and verified correctness.
inclusion_reason: The paper turns full token probability distributions into deterministic response-level selector scores and combines score ranks with answer-frequency votes, making a concrete Best-of-N feedback and trace schema.

title: Problem
问题
html: Best-of-N improves the chance that an LLM produces a useful response, but it still needs a selector. Learned outcome or process reward models add training and inference cost and may shift across models or tasks; majority-based self-consistency only applies when outputs collapse to comparable final answers, and Universal Self-Consistency spends another model call and context window on judging. Self-Certainty instead scores each candidate from probability distributions the generator already produces. The auditable record is a prompt, N sampled responses, every next-token distribution, a scalar self-certainty score and rank per response, answer extraction state, optional Borda votes grouped by answer, and the selected output. The paper evaluates this record shape on mathematics, code reasoning, and code generation, but does not release its candidates, logits, or score manifests.

Best-of-N 能提高 LLM 生成有用回答的概率，但仍需一个选择器。训练式 outcome/process reward model 会增加训练和推理成本，也可能在模型或任务变化时发生分布偏移；基于多数票的 self-consistency 仅适用于可归并为同类最终答案的输出；Universal Self-Consistency 则需额外调用模型，并占用上下文窗口。Self-Certainty 改为利用生成器本就产生的概率分布给每个候选打分。可审计记录应包含 prompt、N 个采样回答、每一步的完整 next-token distribution、每个回答的 self-certainty 标量与排名、答案抽取状态、按答案分组的可选 Borda vote，以及最终选中输出。论文在数学、代码推理和代码生成任务上评估了这种记录结构，但没有发布候选回答、logit 或分数清单。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: For a response of n tokens and vocabulary size V, self-certainty averages KL(U||p) across generation positions: -1/(nV) times the sum over tokens and vocabulary entries of log(V*p). A more non-uniform next-token distribution yields a larger score. Pure Best-of-N returns the highest-scoring response. For tasks with extractable answers, the paper ranks N responses by self-certainty, gives rank r the vote (N-r+1)^p, sums votes for identical answers, and returns the largest total; p=0 is majority voting and large p approaches pure score selection. This feedback contract is deterministic and requires no external reward model, but it estimates generator confidence rather than checking semantic or executable correctness.

设回答长度为 n、词表大小为 V，self-certainty 在所有生成位置上平均 KL(U||p)：即 -1/(nV) 乘以对所有 token 位置和词表项求和的 log(V*p)。next-token distribution 越不均匀，得分越高。纯 Best-of-N 直接返回最高分回答。对于可抽取最终答案的任务，论文先按 self-certainty 排列 N 个回答，再令排名 r 获得 (N-r+1)^p 票，并对相同答案累加；p=0 等价于多数投票，p 很大时趋近于纯分数选择。该反馈契约是确定性的，也不需要外部 reward model，但它衡量的是生成器自身的置信程度，并不验证语义或可执行正确性。

title: Method
方法
html: The main generator is Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. For each prompt, the study samples 64 responses at temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.9, then evaluates N=4, 8, 16, 32, and 64 subsets from identical sample pools; ZeroEval runs the evaluation and main results are averaged across five repetitions. Benchmarks are LiveBench-Math, GSM8K validation, MATH test, CRUXEval-O, and LiveCodeBench. Additional trials use DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B on MATH Level 3 and Qwen-2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct on LiveCodeBench. Invalid fixed-answer extractions are masked and receive negative-infinity confidence in the released selector. For fixed answers, Borda p is tuned by N and task; the paper suggests p=0.3 for N is at most 16 and p=1.2 for N is at least 32 as heuristics, while recommending validation tuning. The author repository extends ZeroEval with self-certainty, Borda, USC, LiveCodeBench parsing, and selection scripts; it contains no candidate-output dataset.

主实验生成器为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。每个 prompt 在 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.9 下采样 64 个回答，再从同一候选池评估 N=4、8、16、32、64；评测由 ZeroEval 执行，主结果取五次重复的平均值。基准包括 LiveBench-Math、GSM8K validation、MATH test、CRUXEval-O 和 LiveCodeBench。补充实验还使用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 测试 MATH Level 3，并使用 Qwen-2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 测试 LiveCodeBench。发布的选择器会屏蔽无法抽取固定答案的响应，并把其置信度设为负无穷。固定答案任务中的 Borda 参数 p 按 N 和任务调整；论文给出 N 不超过 16 时 p=0.3、N 至少为 32 时 p=1.2 的经验值，同时建议在验证集上调参。作者仓库在 ZeroEval 基础上加入 self-certainty、Borda、USC、LiveCodeBench 解析和选择脚本，但不包含候选输出数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across the reported benchmarks, self-certainty often improves over greedy, first-extractable, perplexity, or sampling baselines as N grows, while Borda voting usually improves fixed-answer aggregation. These are selector evaluations, not proof that the score labels process correctness. The paper reports several counterexamples and boundaries: pure self-certainty is below self-consistency on fixed-answer MATH/GSM8K settings; one illustrated highest-confidence wrong response answers 12.5 while the correct answer is 64; the oracle remains far above self-certainty on LiveCodeBench; and an empirical rather than uniform reference distribution degrades GSM8K under distribution shift. Some USC cells are omitted because more than 20 percent of examples exceed the context limit. The official NeurIPS record and author repository verify the paper and implementation, but no raw candidates, full probability arrays, per-item scores, or selection logs were found.

在论文报告的多个基准上，随着 N 增大，self-certainty 往往优于 greedy、first-extractable、perplexity 或 sampling baseline；Borda voting 通常也能改善固定答案聚合。但这些结果只评估选择器，不能证明该分数标注了推理过程的正确性。论文同时给出边界和反例：在固定答案的 MATH/GSM8K 设置中，纯 self-certainty 低于 self-consistency；一个图示中，最高置信度的错误回答给出 12.5，而正确答案是 64；LiveCodeBench 上 oracle 与 self-certainty 之间仍有明显差距；用经验参考分布替代均匀分布时，GSM8K 因分布偏移而退化。部分 USC 单元格未报告，因为超过 20% 的样本超出上下文限制。NeurIPS 官方记录和作者仓库可以核验论文与实现，但没有发现原始候选、完整概率数组、逐样本分数或选择日志。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Relative to average sampled-token log probability or perplexity, self-certainty uses each full vocabulary distribution and measures its divergence from uniform, then averages that signal across the response. Relative to self-consistency, it supplies a scalar for every response, including open-ended code outputs; Borda voting combines this rank with answer frequency instead of choosing between confidence and consensus. Relative to learned reward models, the selector is training-free and model-internal. The direction signal for this atlas is the explicit conversion of rollout token distributions into answer-level scores, ranks, votes, and selected/rejected candidates. KL divergence, Best-of-N, and Borda voting are established tools; the contribution is this full-distribution confidence metric and its use as a scalable selection object.

与 sampled-token 平均对数概率或 perplexity 相比，self-certainty 使用每一步的完整词表分布，计算其相对均匀分布的偏离程度，再在整个回答上取平均。与 self-consistency 相比，它能给每个回答提供标量，包括开放式代码输出；Borda voting 又把该排名与答案频率结合，而不是在置信度和共识之间二选一。与训练式 reward model 相比，该选择器无需训练，信号直接来自模型内部。对本 atlas 而言，方向价值在于把 rollout 的 token distribution 明确转换为答案级分数、排名、票数以及被选中/未选中的候选。KL divergence、Best-of-N 与 Borda voting 都不是新工具；贡献在于这个完整分布置信指标及其作为可扩展选择对象的用法。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Self-certainty measures distributional concentration, not truth. Artificially high-confidence errors can win, and averaging across tokens may hide a localized decisive mistake. Pure self-certainty can underperform majority voting when answers converge; Borda then depends on extraction rules, answer frequency, and the exponent p. The recommended p changes with N, model, and task and is tuned on validation queries, so selection results need a tuning-provenance and leakage audit. Computing the score requires the full vocabulary distribution at every generated token, which is unavailable from many closed APIs and makes raw trace storage much larger than response text. The paper's empirical-reference experiment shows distribution-shift sensitivity, and USC comparisons are incomplete under context overflow. Exact benchmark revisions, generation-length caps, candidate manifests, seeds for every run, and contamination controls beyond LiveBench-Math timing are not fully disclosed. The repository has implementation code but no formal release, raw rollout/logit data, pinned environment, or explicit license. Benchmark gains do not establish score calibration or data quality.

Self-certainty 衡量分布集中度，而不是真实性。置信度异常高的错误可能胜出，对 token 得分取平均也可能掩盖局部但决定性的错误。答案趋同时，纯 self-certainty 可能弱于多数投票；此时 Borda 又依赖答案抽取规则、答案频率和指数 p。推荐的 p 会随 N、模型和任务改变，并在验证查询上调整，因此结果需要记录调参来源，并审计潜在泄漏。该方法要求每个生成 token 的完整词表分布，许多封闭 API 无法提供，而且原始轨迹的存储成本远高于只保存文本。经验参考分布实验暴露了分布偏移敏感性，USC 对比也因上下文溢出而不完整。论文未完全披露精确的基准版本、生成长度上限、候选清单、每次运行的随机种子，以及除 LiveBench-Math 时间关系外的污染控制。仓库提供实现代码，但没有正式 release、原始 rollout/logit 数据、固定环境或明确 license。基准增益不能证明分数校准良好，也不能证明数据质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, the work provides a concrete schema for Best-of-N selection without an external judge. A reusable record should retain prompt and benchmark revision, generator/checkpoint revision, seed, temperature/top-p and maximum length, every candidate response, full token distributions or a reproducible score digest, extraction validity and normalized answer, self-certainty score and rank, Borda p and per-candidate vote, answer totals, selected output, and independent correctness where available. Raw self-certainty, answer-frequency consensus, learned-reward scores, and executable outcomes should remain separate fields. This supports selector comparison and calibration audit without treating intrinsic confidence as a verifier or inferring reuse rights from benchmark performance.

对于 rollout/search/test-time trace 轨道，这项工作提供了一个无需外部 judge 的 Best-of-N 选择记录模式。可复用记录应保留 prompt 与基准版本、生成器/checkpoint 版本、随机种子、temperature/top-p 与最大长度、全部候选回答、完整 token distribution 或可复算的分数摘要、抽取有效性与规范化答案、self-certainty 分数与排名、Borda p 与逐候选票数、各答案总票数、最终选中输出，以及可获得时的独立正确性标签。原始 self-certainty、答案频率共识、learned-reward 得分和可执行结果应分字段保存。这样可以比较选择器并审计校准，又不会把模型内生置信度误当作 verifier，也不会从基准成绩推断复用权利。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Self-certainty averages KL(U||p) over every token position and therefore requires full vocabulary distributions, not only sampled-token log probabilities.
  • Main experiments draw 64 candidates at temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.9, then evaluate N=4-64 subsets over five repetitions.
  • Pure self-certainty selects one response; fixed-answer Borda voting combines confidence rank with answer frequency using (N-r+1)^p.
  • High confidence can be wrong, p requires task-specific tuning, and self-consistency can outperform pure self-certainty on convergent answers.
  • The author code is public, but raw candidates, logits, score manifests, exact revisions, and repository license remain unavailable.

• Self-certainty 在每个 token 位置平均 KL(U||p)，因此需要完整词表分布，而不只是被采样 token 的 log probability。
  • 主实验以 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.9 生成 64 个候选，再用五次重复评估 N=4--64 的子集。
  • 纯 self-certainty 选择单个回答；固定答案的 Borda voting 用 (N-r+1)^p 把置信度排名和答案频率结合起来。
  • 高置信度可能对应错误，p 需要按任务调参；答案趋同时，self-consistency 可能优于纯 self-certainty。
  • 作者代码已公开，但原始候选、logit、分数清单、精确版本和仓库 license 仍未提供。
